<subject>Draft of Transition Team Memo to David Larsen</subject>
<body>
David,  

As we just talked about, here is the transition memo recommending you reach out to Stephen Mclaughlin.  

As mentioned in the memo, we are still coordinating with legal on the type of leave our employees must take while working on the internal transition versus the externally funded transition. The resolution of this issue could affect their willingness to participate in some cases.
</body>
